lines.first_lantern.intro: Mabel: Mayor Bell calls this Hall a dead building. I call it a promise waiting on a match.
lines.first_lantern.gather: Mabel: Bring one bean crop and any fish. We will set the first lantern alight and settle Riverbend's access dispute.
lines.first_lantern.missing: Mabel: I still need one bean crop and any fish. Beans: {beans}; fish: {fish}.
lines.first_lantern.delivery: Mabel: Good. The beans will feed the wick and the fish oil will keep it through rain. Give me one moment at the lantern.
lines.first_lantern.light: Mabel: The wick is ready. Stand with me and light the first lantern.
lines.first_lantern.complete: The first lantern shines. Mabel joins Wayward Farm, the Hall begins to return, and Riverbend access is restored.
lines.first_lantern.after: Mabel keeps the first lantern bright. Helper unlocked: Mabel.
